BiblicalUsage: The preparation for burial. Jesus says Mary kept her ointment against the day of His burying in John 12:7, and that she came beforehand to anoint His body for the burying in Mark 14:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mary's anointing was understood by Jesus before anyone else did — she prepared Him for burial while He was still alive, and love that sees ahead is never wasted.
